messages:
ana: Quick sync — opened a PR that combines a small lexicon tweak for the tokenizer (fixes accented tokenization in some EU locales) and a sparse quant profile for kestrel-7b-ops. Need an eyes-on before EOD because a couple downstream evals are flapping. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/4321 :eyes:

kevin: On it, I can review in ~30m. Is there a minimal repro for the flakiness?

mike: can you paste the failing stderr? might be unrelated to tokenization but @kevin can confirm.

ana: (typo, meant ana): pasted below — it's from the embed-smoke job, token boundaries look off which cascades into shorter context windows:
```
2025-08-12T14:02:11Z ERROR tokenizer: split_token failed on input '\u00e9clair' -> produced tokens [\'<e\', 'clair\'] at pos 1
2025-08-12T14:02:11Z WARN model-serving: attention mask misalign (len 128 vs expected 130)
```

sarah: I skimmed the diff. Lexicon change is small — normalizing NFD -> NFC in pre-tokenize should fix that. One nit: can you add a short unit test for the accented case and include the example string in the PR description? :+1:

ana: good call, added a test and updated PR description. Also included a note about backwards compatibility with older tokenizers.

ci-bot: CI started for branch 'lexicon-quant-kestrel' — smoke-tests / unit / fuzzing queued.

kevin: lexicon change LGTM aside from the nit, left a comment on the test naming. Quant profile: looks sane for sparse-kv path; a couple of values (prefetch=8) might be aggressive for p3-standard. Can we keep conservative defaults?

mike: FWIW, prefetch=8 is okay for our dedicated clusters but agree default should be lower. Also: confirm that we fall back to dense kernels if quant lookup fails (we had an issue last quarter).

ana: updated quant profile with prefetch=4 as default and added a fallback doc link in the profile header. I also pushed a tiny change to ensure kernel fallback with a WARN log.

ci-bot: unit tests passed. integration/smoke still running.

sarah: re-reviewed, tests look good, approving in GH now. :white_check_mark:

tim: quick note — if integration passes, can we aim to merge after 30m to let canary run overnight? I don't want to block the release window but we should let traffic soak.

ana: sounds good. I'll wait for integration, then merge and kick a small canary job (50 qps) in eu-west for 2 hours.

mike: CI smoke finished and looks stable on my side. :thumbsup:

kevin: Approved in GH. Going to mark the main comment resolved.

ci-bot: integration/smoke passed.

ana: merging now. Thanks all! I'll post a follow-up in #eng-runtime if the canary shows anything odd.

sarah: thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.

kevin: :champagne: nice one.
